title: Ring Definition v2
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/ring/models.py::RingDefinition — the composed internal ring domain model, built from a real JewelryDefinition by ring_definition_from_jdl(). This is a domain contract UNDERNEATH JDL, not a second canonical JDL schema: the authoritative external input format remains backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py (mirrored at shared/types/jewelry-definition.ts); this schema describes the internal RingDefinition v2 model the adapter produces from it. See docs/bible/18-ring-architecture/523-ring-definition-model.md.

setting.description: SettingAttachmentDefinition — the setting itself, separated from how it structurally attaches to the ring head (see 530-setting-attachment-contract.md). No dedicated file in this Sprint's spec set; defined inline here since it composes only into RingDefinition today.
